event_name: Date 08 September 2019 Time 16:21 2019 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 54), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 7 started the race on a set of tyres that were not those used to set the fastest lap in Q2.
offence: Breach of Article 24.4 j) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: 10 Second Stop and Go Penalty (mandatory – as prescribed by Article 24.4 j).
reason: Having received a report from the Technical delegate that car 7 started the race on the wrong set of tyres, the Stewards find this to be a breach of the regulations and impose the mandatory penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 7 Wrong Tyres Used
